cases.why: officer-login and service-token success. TWO FIELDS. This is the shape, not an abridgement of it.

THE CENTRAL IAM GAP, pinned as a fixture. Login returns no user, no agency, no roles. A console that expects them here is expecting an endpoint that does not exist (GET /v1/auth/officer/me is proposed, not built).
There is no refresh token and no refresh endpoint. An officer token is valid until it expires, by design (ADR-016); the UI re-authenticates.
One shape for unknown handle, wrong password AND disabled account. No enumeration.
The two grants have DIFFERENT 401 codes. INVALID_CLIENT belongs to the service-token route.
service-token 401. Unknown client, wrong secret and disabled client are one shape here too — the enumeration discipline is identical to login.
The field is loginHandle, not email or username. A login form bound to the wrong name is a 400 on every submit.
Controller checks length === 0 before anything else. Empty is a 400, not an auth failure.
Shape error. Deliberately NOT a signal about whether the handle exists.
